entities.name: Martina Veličková
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martina Rašková Veličková, is a Slovak women's ice hockey forward, most recently of ŽHK Šarišanka Prešov in the 2017–18 season of the Slovak Women's Extraliiga. She served as captain of the Slovak national team in the women's ice hockey tournament at the 2010 Olympic Winter Games in Vancouver.
